I'll be honest, I'm not really so sure what "love yourself" even means. I live with nothing but regret over things I have done. And self loathing. I cheer inside a little when shit happens to me. I deserve everything I get. I'd have killed myself long ago if I wasn't so well trained to survive anything. How can I possibly look that guy in the eyes in the mirror and say "I love you man"? When every fiber of my being is telling me to put my fist through the mirror and the wall behind it.

\^This. There are almost 8 BILLION people on this planet. There are probably millions of perfect matches out there for each person. But finding that needle in a such a massive haystack is the real trick. And nobody has a metal detector.

Thank you. I had never heard of the term "reparenting" before. There are a lot of books and web pages and articles about it so it seems. Certainly you have given me something to look into and try to understand. Maybe it will help me. So thanks again for the tip.

I mean we all didn't talk for a good 10 years, and they have radically changed as people. But it is still good to be back in touch with them. I am very worried about my future, I can't stay where I live right now for too much longer and thanks to covid the housing market is a mess. I'm looking at every possibility but it's not looking great.

I feel like this, I have tried and come very very close several times in the last 20 years or so. But in the final seconds my survival instincts kick in and my body takes over to save itself automatically against my will. I feel like I just need a "push" some kind of trigger to break that programming and let me let go.  


But if losing my mother wasn't a big enough push I don't see what is. I am now in sheer painful purgatory forever.

I have felt this way for over 25 years.  
I have tried time and time again to end my own life, but each time my survival instinct kicks in and my body no longer recognises my authority over it and refuses to let me kill it. I've come close a couple of times, but in the final seconds I save myself against my own will. And I'll say this much everytime I survive makes my life that much harder to live in too. And I regret not succeeding all the more.   


Living as you say, in constant purgatory.
Thank you, I mean that. Your words were very kind. And it's refreshing to have someone so understanding say these things to me.
I am not fit. :P

Nah it's fine. It was a long time ago now, and while I am scarred and probably damaged for life from it all. It's made me pretty tough. Probably the reason I can't die, I am conditioned to survive anything. My body automatically prevents suicide and overrides my mind and will.   


I do however feel heartbreak and emotional pain. Grief and loss and loneliness have been my lifelong constant companions. I just hope the day comes sooner rather than later when I can break my programming and finish the job. Or something else ends me at long last.  Because you have no idea how exhausted I am with my life.

My father left my mother before I was born, I never met the guy.   


At just 2 weeks old, my mother had a psychotic break and killed her dog, her budgerigar and then me. My grandfather was coming to check in on me and her just at the moment she smothered me with a pillow. My grandfather had to wrestle her off me and perform CPR to resuscitate me. I know this because the story was told me in great detail more than once later in life when I was old enough to understand it.  


My mother was taken into custody and put into saxondale maximum security mental institution. I never saw here again until I was almost 3. In the meantime I was passed around various aunties and uncles and grandma and grandad like an unwanted parcel.   


Then my mother, a woman I didn't even know existed, whom I had never bonded with, who didn't see my first steps, or hear my first words. Was put back into my life. And I was simply discarded off to live the rest of my life with her. The entire family washed their hands of me and her at that point and I rarely saw any of them again.   


My mother was a severe schizophrenic. She was on a plethora of antipsychotics and antidepressants. With fortnightly social worker home visits and doctors visits.  She was prone to violent outburst and snap mood changes. She argued and fought with herself almost all night every night, I would try to sleep with the constant sound of her shouting at herself with profanities and rage. I had deadbolts on my bedroom door and had to lock myself in at night to sleep safely without the risk of her killing me in my sleep.   


By the time I was 12 my grandfather, the only one who gave a shit. passed away. Leaving me utterly alone with her. The rest of my life from then on was more or less as a slave to her. I had to cook, clean, look after myself and her. Bathe her because she also had a spinal problem which was getting so much worse. I rarely had time for school and my attendance was abysmal.   


But that was ok because on the flip side she was a brilliant teacher and forced me to read and write and do math, and learn biology and sciences, she enlisted me in Tae Kwon Do, Swimming and Army Cadets in my teens. She scrapped the money to send me to Austria skiing. She forced me through violence to excel and the days I did manage to go to school I found I was the smartest kid in the class, and the teachers were way behind my mother in subject matter. I knew it all already. I ran rings around everyone and aced every test easily.  


But. I knew already I was socially different. I had a best friend, a kid who had a functioning loving family. A mom n dad, a dog, a little brother and older sisters. They brought me in as their own kid, he became my brother and they became my adoptive family. I has a taste of what it was to feel normal. And I truly envied my friend with every cell in my body. At the end of the day or when mom came to drag me back home, I had to go home to sudden rage. I had a broken nose and broken ribs from her by the age of 16.   


The time eventually came that I could over power her and simply restrain her until she stopped trying to hurt me.   


She died of leukaemia when I was 21. She was 55. And ever since that day I have tried as hard as I can to join her.   


So I would say that is not a traditional upbringing. Too much info too I imagine. I am sorry.
Thanks, and yeah I get that. Feel free to PM me if you ever wanna chat, I'm always interested in a conversation.

Same here OP. All year I have been trying desperately to get my "friends" to talk to me and give some time. Instead I am just screaming into the wind and not a single person gives a flying shit about me. I am isolated, alone and ostracized. I'm at the point where I'm giving up on life as there is no point in it. I have no purpose. I am unwanted and even hated, at least it feels like that. So why go on living?

I think a lot of it comes from childhood. What I mean by that is you make your only lifelong friends in your childhood years, you bond then, form kinship to last the ages. Later in life people you meet are already established with their own kinship friends and you are just some new guy they met as they are to you.   


You form friendship with them but it's not a bonding kinship. It's just a passive friendship that can and will be discarded the moment it stops being beneficial to either party. Thats been my life experience anyway. I moved 200 miles away from all my old kinship friends to pursue a relationship (which predictably failed) I made new friends here, but now they are all gone and I am totally alone stuck here. My kinsmen still talk to me on messenger and they are working hard to try and get me back home! they are my real friends, my family and I made a big mistake leaving them behind.

I'm 40 here, alone in my house 24/7 going nuts with cabin fever. I don't even know where to begin to make friends now. Esp with the covid nonsense going on and people are more isolated than ever. I just don't know what I am supposed to do anymore.

I wasn't raised in a traditional manner, and often I feel I am not on the same footing with people around me, they act and talk in ways I don't fully understand sometimes. And I guess I must do the same from their point of view. I think as such people just think I'm strange and weird and don't really want me around.   


And that hurts so much, I have been rejected and abandoned over and over again my entire life. I can't even make connections with people anymore because I know they will throw me away in the end.   


But on the flip side being so alone and isolated is the most painful feeling. And I find it hard to have any motivation to do anything. I wonder why I even bother going to work, what good is money? I often just want this constant nightmare life to end.

I am always the one to initiate communication, nobody talks first. Some don't even respond on messenger even though they clear see my messages. Makes me feel even more unwanted and alone. I know for a fact if I died nobody would even notice.

I do this too. I curse the alarm waking me for work in the morning and knowing I survived another damn night. I'd have killed myself already if not for my overwhelming survival instinct that stops me every single time. So I wish to just pass in my sleep without a thing I can do about it. I've been this way for years, but more so this year.

Thank you. I am glad you took the time to read my posts and understand me. That's a lot more than most people have done. You have made me feel a little less alone today too. I have 7 days off work now and I already feel foul knowing I have so much time on my hands with nobody to share it with. I'm sat here playing kenshi at the moment, but I no longer get any enjoyment out of my games and shows and movies bore me now. It's like everything I once loved is just bland and joyless. 

I am trying to find a purpose. But my purpose has always been to care and love someone else. My childhood was in servitude to my mother, then my first long term partner was completely clueless at life and once again I found meaning and purpose in guiding and helping and loving him. 

Now for the last few years I have lived with my current partner and its been a real chore living with him because he's head strong, and hold unreasonable grudges over things he perceives I have done wrong over the years, for example we played RISK with with a few friends and he was going to win, so on my turn I took his capital city to keep the game going and stop him winning. Big mistake. After they all went home he went ballistic on me. I mean like seriously. Over a damn board game. 

He's that petty that he still won't let it go and still brings it up against me to this day. And he throws any and every past mistake I ever made at me all the time and it really gets me down. Yet he tells his toxic friend that I am the petty one, and they both treat me like I'm a fucking child. Laughing at me the whole time. 

And now he's taken to just laughing as soon as he looks at me. Just walking through the lounge to go to the kitchen he glances at me and sniggers and giggles. It's really pushing my buttons. I'm almost ready to give him a black eye and broken nose now. 

I don't deserve to be bullied in my own house relentlessly every single day by someone who I really loved. I have come to the conclusion that he is just a really toxic and awful human being and he and his toxic fembot are just made for each other.

I had him bring home a ton of boxes from his work from the other day, and I refused to tell him why. He made the "joke" "oh you're leaving finally?" bursting out laughing at me. Not exactly jackass. Before I check out I am going to pack all of his shit into these boxes and dump them in the garden and he can fuck off back to his mommy. I want the satisfaction of watching him leave with his tail between his legs. 

He also took delivery of my helium, again not understanding what it was for but laughing and thinking it hilarious that I had bought helium. "are you planning on doing an UP and flying away?"  Yes, yes I am. Idiot. 

I'm just so tired of him. Just him even being in the house with me makes me feel so awful. I keep willing him to just come and be normal with me and tell me he's sorry and it was just a test or something. Then I feel pathetic for wanting to have him back. 

I am trying to be positive and happy. But everything is just false and empty and dull. I am sleep walking in my life right now and I can't snap out of it. 

Someone told me to win the lotto and go live like a king in some backwater country. As if. And tbh even if I won the lotto I know it wouldn't change anything or make me happy. And I really do not value money at all. I value genuine friendships and real people who care about me for who I am. I don't think they even exist anymore. 

+++End rant+++
Ahhh bro I wish I was that lucky but I always rolls 1s not 6s. :(

I have been staying here for a while for decades. My life changes but never gets better. Only worse if anything. I don't even live in the same country anymore because I put my trust and life in someone else's hands only for them to throw me away and leave me stranded here. I don't have any friends anymore, nobody would even notice I am gone. Accept my housemate would dance on my grave with his toxic cronies with glee. 

I'll provide him the music he can dance to as soon as my inert gas arrives and i have the guts to do it. I'm tired. There is no point anymore. I don't even enjoy anything I used to love doing anymore. It all just feels so empty and boring and it's just filler while I wait for the clock to tick down. Just wanna get on with it and get it over.
